title: &6Act III: &fThe Deep
subtitle: Drowned skies, buried cities, the Old Powers. Levels 30–50.

quests.title: &e♪ &6The Tale of the Old Powers
quests.subtitle: Older than the Crown. Maybe older than the sun.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"Some things are older than the Crown, Ashborn. Older than the sun, maybe.&r

&f&oThe Warden in the deep dark, who listens for heartbeats. The Drowned Keeper under the sea. The Wither, which is only hunger with three mouths. And the Dragon at the edge of the world. They never knelt to the Crown, and the Sovereigns were wise enough to leave them alone.&r
&f&oEach of them keeps a relic of the world before. Not light, exactly. Memory. What the world was like when it was young.&r
&f&oYou'll need that memory where you're going. The storm-lord waits beneath the waves, and the gardener behind her roses. Go down. The deep has been waiting for someone to bother it."&r
Three embers burn and the Rime Veil is thawing. The meltwater has to go somewhere. It goes down, into places older than the Crown, and it is waking what sleeps there.

The &5Old Powers&r are the world's first guardians: the &6Warden&r, the &6Elder Guardian&r, the &6Wither&r and the &6Ender Dragon&r. Each keeps a &6Relic&r, and the Relics are the only things left that remember the sun as it was.

quests.title: &6The Deep
quests.subtitle: The dark was here before the Eclipse.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"Quiet down there. Not the polite kind. The kind that is listening back."&r
The &8ancient cities&r were built by people who chose the dark before the dark was forced on anyone. Nobody knows why. Their streets are still lit by soul fire, and something still walks them.
&7Find an ancient city in the deep dark.

quests.title: &5The Listener
quests.subtitle: Old Power: the Warden.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"It can't see you. It doesn't need to. Every heart is a drum to it, and yours is louder than most."&r
The Warden was set to guard the deep cities when their builders left, and told to listen. It has been listening ever since, and it has grown very, very tired of what it hears.
&7It's blind, it hears your heartbeat and it hits harder than anything you've met. You don't have to fight fair. Its Relic becomes &6Shadowfang&7, the dagger that strikes from where you are not.

quests.title: The Otherside
quests.subtitle: Below the deep dark, something deeper.
description: Some ancient cities hide a frame of reinforced sculk. Beyond it lies the &5Otherside&r: an echo of the world the Wardens remember, preserved the way a shell keeps the sound of the sea. The &5Stalker&r hunts there.
&7Enter the Otherside.

quests.title: &5The Drowned Keeper
quests.subtitle: Old Power: the Elder Guardian.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"The sea kept a secret for the world. Three old things guard it, and they curse anyone who swims too close. Swim close."&r
Deep in the &3ocean monuments&r, three Elder Guardians keep the sea's oldest memory: the first sunrise, sunk in a vault of prismarine so it could never be stolen.
&7Find a monument and kill an Elder Guardian.

quests.title: The Drowned Sky
quests.subtitle: Kaelthar spoke to the storm.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪

&f&o"Kaelthar was afraid of the dark, so he kept the one thing that still flashed: lightning. He drowned his own coast to keep the storm close. Every bolt you see out there is him, still talking to it."&r
&6Kaelthar the Stormcaller&r, Sovereign of the Drowned Sky, flooded his kingdom to keep the storm for himself. His token is a &6lightning rod&r.
&7Before him, the drowned coast has other things to fight: a sunken city with a Leviathan, a kraken's ship, a frozen pirate captain. None is required. All of them will teach you about water.

&7His offering is the one thing he kept: lightning. The Ashen Works can box it. Bring a &6Basic Energy Cell&7 (a machine frame, a circuit, iron and blocks of redstone). It need not be charged. He will know what it is for.

quests.title: The Leviathan
quests.subtitle: The sunken city is not empty.
description: Under the ocean lies a &3sunken city&r, drowned when Kaelthar called the sea in. Something vast lives there now, and it drags whatever it catches down into the abyss to keep.
&7Bring water breathing. Bring friends. Kill the Leviathan.

quests.title: The Kraken's Ship
quests.subtitle: A wreck that still has a captain.
description: A Crown warship went down in Kaelthar's storm with every hand aboard. The crew are long gone. The thing that sank it never left.
&7Kill the Kraken.

quests.title: &6Sovereign: Kaelthar the Stormcaller
quests.subtitle: Sovereign of the Drowned Sky. Level 30.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"Four embers. Listen. No thunder. For the first time in an age, the sea is just the sea. Halfway, Ashborn. Halfway home."&r
He calls lightning down where you stand. The storm loves him back, which is the saddest thing about him.
&7Keep moving, never stand still for a whole breath, and never fight him in the rain if you can help it.
&7His sigil needs the &6Seal of the Hunt&7 in the grid. It stays there.

quests.title: &cThe Ancient Remnant
quests.subtitle: Older than Ossukage. Older than the Crown.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"Before the Crown, there was a king of sand who refused to die. He was the first. Everything rising out there learned it from him."&r
The Hollow Sovereign's warrior, Ossukage, likes to call himself the first Remnant. He's wrong.
Under the desert sleeps a pharaoh-thing that rose again before there was a Crown to serve: the &cAncient Remnant&r. The Eclipse didn't make it. It made the Eclipse feel at home.
&7Wake it. Then survive it.

quests.title: The Cursed Keep
quests.subtitle: Tier III of the dungeon trail.
description: In the hot, wet places stands the &6Cursed Keep&r. Its Warlord died defending it in the first year of the dark. He didn't notice. He's still defending it.
&7Kill the Keep's Warlord.

quests.title: The Abyssal Halls
quests.subtitle: The deepest Labyrinth.
description: The deepest prison the Sovereigns dug, for the thing they feared most. Whatever it was, they were right to.
&7Clear the Abyssal Halls and kill their guardian.

quests.title: The Scarlet Garden
quests.subtitle: Ysolde grew flowers in blood.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"Ysolde loved her garden more than her court. When the sun went out, the flowers started dying, so she fed them. First the servants. Then the court. Then herself, a little, every day."&r
&6Ysolde, the Crimson Bloom&r, Sovereign of the Scarlet Garden, kept her roses alive in the dark at any price. Her token is a &cblock of redstone&r, the colour of everything she ever loved.
&7Gather six Fragments and a block of redstone.
&7Her offering is a &6Poppet&7: the Hollow Wood Coven's doll of wheat and string around an amethyst shard, made to stand in for a person. She fed her court to her roses. Send her one more courtier.

quests.title: &6Sovereign: Ysolde, the Crimson Bloom
quests.subtitle: Sovereign of the Scarlet Garden. Level 35.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"Five embers. More than half the sun. Look up tonight, Ashborn. The sky is not black any more. It's dark blue. Tell me you can't see it."&r
Her garden dies with her. Something in you will be sorry about that, and you should let it.
&7She bleeds you: &cHemorrhage&7 builds with every cut and bursts for a share of your health. Don't let her chain combos; one clean roll beats three panicked ones.
&7Her sigil needs the &6Seal of the Hunt&7 in the grid. It stays there.
